target_capability: adding and registering a task variant
assertions: The response creates only a per-task YAML and reuses the existing base via include.
The response uses the CoT suffix in the task name but not in the dataset config name.
The response registers the task in the appropriate task list.
The response verifies the registration with the bundled task-YAML inventory tool.
The response does not create a new base YAML or edit shared utilities.
